title: Microstructure and Properties of Aluminum-Containing Refractory High-Entropy Alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting nominal mixtures of elements, remelted five times, flipped for each melt, in liquid state for 5 min per melt. Hot isostatically pressed at 1400°C and 207 MPa for 2 h, annealed at 1400°C for 24 h in flowing argon.
